Runtime dependencies are included locally so the site does not need a CDN.
Three.js 0.180.0: https://github.com/mrdoob/three (MIT; licence in three/LICENSE).
qrcode 1.5.4: https://github.com/soldair/node-qrcode (MIT; qrcode-LICENSE.txt).
The QR bundle includes dijkstrajs (MIT; dijkstrajs-LICENSE.md).
